    Corners, repeated labels and graded covers of ray tables (Lemma 4.7 for kP) #

    • restrict P W: the full subtable on a set W of vertices; its linearization is the idempotent corner of kP at ∑_{x ∈ W} e_x (restrictEquiv), so it is representation-finite with kP (Lemma 3.1(1)).
    • infl P v: repeated labels v : κ → V; representation-finite with kP by Morita equivalence through a full idempotent (as in Lemma 4.7, first step).
    • cover P γ v g: the full subcategory of the graded covering category on the objects (v i, g i), for a grading γ of the rays; representation-finite with kP by the split transfer of Lemma 4.6 (lem:homogeneous-projection).

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.

    Restriction to a set of vertices #
